g.text: A deck is a load path: boards to joists, joists to the ledger and the beam, beam to posts, posts to footings.
The ledger fails quietly: it is bolted to a building the deck does not own.
Sizes and spans are fictional; span tables decide them in practice.
DECK 16 ft x 12 ft (IRC R507 / DCA 6)
1 LEDGER, bolted to the band joist
and the load has nowhere to go
